Patron Note Program
Invest in Your Cooperative with the Patron Note Program
The Crystal Valley Patron Note Program gives member-owners a simple way to invest directly in the cooperative. By purchasing unsecured, interest-bearing certificates, you help strengthen Crystal Valley’s financial foundation while earning a return on your investment.
This program is one more way member-ownership delivers value beyond the field. It reflects our cooperative commitment to transparency, shared success, and local reinvestment.
